name: JustiSolve
description: JustiSolve mobile client for private legal workspaces, role profiles, case records and configured AI tools. Uses your existing account and the live JustiSolve platform.
limitations: Development preview, internet required. Downloads, camera/video and unsupported flows may require Browser sign-in. No native background calls, push notifications or offline case work. No Google Play or Apple App Store publication.
